name: Kiarash Farahmandrad
_seo_note: url, brand, description and og_image feed every meta tag, the JSON-LD, robots.txt and sitemap.xml. tools/build-content.mjs writes all four from here, so the address lives in exactly one place.
_og_note: og.png is the 1200x630 link-preview card, generated by `npm run og`. Keep it at that size: LinkedIn will not show a large card below 1200x627, and Telegram and WhatsApp centre-crop anything squarer. Point og_image somewhere else only if the replacement is the same shape.
description: Kiarash Farahmandrad is a multi-disciplinary designer in Tehran working across logo and identity design, posters, 3D, XR and motion. Selected work, clients and CV.
_email_note: Split into parts on purpose. The full address is never written out in any file the browser downloads, so scrapers that grep for user@host.tld find nothing. index.html reassembles it at runtime.
clients_lede: The list runs from technology platforms to cultural institutions. Some arrived for a single mark; others for a system a whole team would go on to run.
_i18n_note: `default` is the language index.html and content.json are written in; the others are served as content.<lang>.json and reached at ?lang=<lang>. Adding a language here is half the job — the other half is the sibling markdown: about.fr.md beside about.md, index.fr.md beside index.md. A missing translation falls back to the default, so a language can be added before its content exists. Every language shipped so far is left-to-right; an rtl one needs work in index.html that is not currently there.
_locales_note: Per-language overrides of the fields above. Anything left out keeps the default language's value. `details` and `client_names` replace their object wholesale rather than merging key by key, because their keys are themselves display text. `client_names` maps the English name a clients/ filename yields onto its translation — it is the one place a client can be renamed for a language, and it feeds both the logo tiles and the engagements list.

fr.description: Kiarash Farahmandrad est un designer multidisciplinaire basé à Téhéran, actif en identité visuelle et logotypes, affiches, 3D, XR et motion. Travaux choisis, clients et CV.
fr.clients_lede: La liste va des plateformes technologiques aux institutions culturelles. Certains sont venus chercher une seule marque ; d'autres, un système qu'une équipe entière allait faire vivre.
